title: IS YOUR MODEL REALLY A GOOD MATH REASONER? EVALUATING MATHEMATICAL REASONING WITH CHECKLIST

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on GPT-generated questions versus non-GPT-generated questions (Original Problem & Outcome Judging) to determine if GPT models have an unfair advantage or inflated performance on self-generated benchmark data.

Comparing model performance on standard public benchmarks (GSM8k) against an uncontaminated private dataset (GSM1k) to measure artificially inflated scores caused by models overfitting to contaminated training data.
